label_definitions.ambiguous: Prompt/output does not support a reliable binary semantic judgment.
label_definitions.semantically_correct: Output conveys the gold answer despite a surface-form mismatch.
label_definitions.semantically_incorrect: Output conveys a different answer, abstains incorrectly, fails to abstain, or is uninterpretable.

population: full_k7 official exact-match failures on v2.2 TEST
review_protocol: Single-pass manual inspection of all fixed prompt/gold/output triples; official condition hidden only to the extent possible because method is part of the predeclared balanced sample.
selection_rule: For each method, group by (decision, reasoning_family), sort each group by SHA256(selection_version:method:example_id), then round-robin groups to 50.
